note: Majority: the Civil Code (Code civil, Livre I), article 488 as replaced by the law of 19 January 1990: majority is at eighteen full years, capable of every act of civil life. Emancipation, including by marriage, is not held. Work: the Labour Law of 16 March 1971 (loi sur le travail), article 6 (in force 1 February 1993): 'children' are minors under fifteen or still bound by full-time compulsory schooling, and article 7.1 forbids making them work; held as fifteen, though a minor still in full-time compulsory schooling past fifteen is a child too (not held), as are the student-work and apprenticeship rules. Performers: article 7.2 allows individual derogations only for a child's taking part as actor, extra, singer, musician, dancer or model in cultural, scientific, educational or artistic events, recordings, broadcasts and photo sessions; the derogation is written, for a set duration and activity, given by the competent official on a written application from a person domiciled in Belgium, and the article sets hours windows by age (until 19h to age 6, 22h from 7 to 11, 23h from 12 to 15), not held. No age floor is set. Service: the coordinated Militia Laws of 30 April 1962, article 1bis (inserted by the law of 31 December 1992, in force 18 January 1993), apply only to the militia classes of 1993 and earlier, so no one has been called since; the laws are suspended, not repealed.

sources.title: Justel (SPF Justice): Code civil, Titre préliminaire et Livre I, article 488
sources.said: La majorité est fixée à dix-huit ans accomplis; à cet âge, on est capable de tous les actes de la vie civile.

sources.title: Justel (SPF Justice): Loi sur le travail du 16 mars 1971, articles 6 to 7.15
sources.said: " enfants " : des mineurs âgés de moins de 15 ans ou qui sont encore soumis à l'obligation scolaire à temps plein. ... Il est interdit de faire ou de laisser travailler des enfants ... Des dérogations individuelles à l'interdiction de faire ou de laisser exercer des activités par des enfants, peuvent uniquement être accordées pour permettre la participation d'enfants : ... 1.1. comme acteur, figurant, chanteur, musicien ou danseur à des manifestations de caractère culturel, scientifique, éducatif ou artistique

sources.title: Justel (SPF Justice): Lois coordonnées sur la milice du 30 avril 1962, article 1bis
sources.said: Art. 1bis . <Inséré par L 1992-12-31/30, art. 1, En vigueur : 18-01-1993> La présente loi est applicable aux miliciens de la levée de 1993 et des levées antérieures.
